verdict.rationale: The pricing docs say sandboxes have a default 5-minute timeout. Developers can set it with the `timeout` option at creation and extend it with `sandbox.extendTimeout()`. Because this appears on the pricing page, it implies runtime billing ends when the sandbox stops, and Spend Management adds a cost backstop. Missing for 10: an idle-based (inactivity) timeout distinct from a fixed lifetime, an explicit statement that billing stops at timeout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
